t: This is the St Marylebone War Memorial in St John's Wood, a sculpture of Saint George and the dragon. Saint George was an early Christian martyr who, according to tradition, served as a soldier in the Roman army. Since the Crusades he has been honoured especially as a military saint, which is why he turns up on so many war memorials. The sculpture was made by Charles Leonard Hartwell, an English sculptor who worked in bronze and marble.
